params.body:
The cides.be rebuild to the designer's handoff of October 2026: new design system, every page, a new content model in Sanity and the migration that fills it.

Supersedes #18 and #17 (same branch content plus the changes below); both can be closed.

## Since #18

- **Google tag: Ads `AW-16615952211` and Analytics `G-ZRS77ZE4DR`, behind Consent Mode v2.** Every page sets the four consent types to denied; gtag.js is not loaded until the visitor agrees in a consent banner (NL/EN, in the design system, agree and refuse look the same). Refuse keeps it denied and removes Google's `_gcl`/`_ga` cookies; the choice is kept for twelve months, "Cookie settings" in the footer reopens the banner. No third-party banner service.
- **CSP** opens exactly the hosts gtag needs (Google's CSP guide, plus `googleads.g.doubleclick.net` for scripts, which the remarketing request needs in practice). Tag IDs and hosts live together in `web/src/consent/google-tag.mjs`; adding GA4 is one `G-` ID there and opens its own hosts. Still no `'unsafe-inline'`.
- **Alt text review in the Studio.** A tool "Alt-teksten" lists every image the site shows (173, with the seven fixed photos in the web code) with a proposed Dutch and English alt, written per image in the context of its page. The reviewer saves under their own Studio login into the draft `drafts.alt-review`, which publishes nothing and starts no build; `npm run alts:apply` then sets every reviewed alt in one transaction (production only with `--webhook-paused`). Tested on staging and reverted.
- `SANITY_STUDIO_HOST` lets a second hosted Studio (for example on staging) run next to `cides.sanity.studio`.
- Checked in a browser: first visit 0 requests to Google; after agree the tag, conversion and remarketing requests load with no CSP error; after refuse the cookie is gone and nothing loads on the next page. Lighthouse unchanged (CLS 0).

## Since #17

- Page transitions: the red bar stays put, the page swaps with a short fade (0.18 s), and a case card's photo grows into the case hero and back (0.4 s ease). Cross-document view transitions; off under `prefers-reduced-motion`, plain loads in browsers without them.
- The cases filter swaps sectors with the same fade.
- On 320 px screens the phase titles on Home no longer widen the page before the web font arrives.

**Do not merge before the production dataset is migrated.** The new pages read fields only the migration writes (sectors, gallery rows, hero stills, logos, posts). Merged first, the live site builds without its cases. The order: pause the rebuild webhook, run the migration on `production`, merge this PR (that push is the one build), re-enable the webhook.

## Preview

The deploy preview reads the `staging` dataset (`[context.deploy-preview.environment]` in `netlify.toml`), which holds a copy of production with the migration applied. Production builds keep the dataset set in the Netlify UI.

## What changes

- **Design system.** Tokens as CSS custom properties (12 colours, type scale, spacing), Barlow Condensed / Roboto / Roboto Mono self-hosted. Tailwind, Open Sans and PT Serif removed. No radius, no shadow.
- **Pages.** Home (hero crossfade, sectors, phases, logo wall), Cases with a sector filter that works in place and a route per sector (`/cases/<sector>/`), 26 case pages, About us, Our approach, Contact (Netlify form `contact`, same field names, inline success), Blog with categories and the first article, 404. Case and article photos open large on click. Pages swap with a short fade and the case card photo grows into the case hero.
- **Languages.** Dutch at the root, English at `/en/`. French dropped: `/fr/*` 301s to the English page.
- **URLs.** `/projects/*` moves to `/cases/*` with 301s for every current and legacy slug; Portio F1, Smart Cat and Boston (not in the design) go to the overview; `/our-story` to `/about-us/`, `/services` to `/our-approach/`.
- **Sanity.** `project` keeps its type and IDs, labelled "Case" in the Studio, with new fields (sector, product, hero, card image, gallery rows, client note, confidential, hidden). New types: sector, clientNote, post, postCategory, heroStill, clientLogo. French stays in the documents as hidden fields. Old fields are hidden, not deleted.
- **Migration.** `npm run migrate:design -- --dataset <name> --uploads <dir> [--write]`: one transaction (67 mutations, 142 images), dry by default, and it refuses to write `production` without `--webhook-paused`.
- **CSP.** Still hashes only, now one header rule per page (scoped styles give each page its own hashes).

## Checked

- Every page against its prototype at 1280 and 390 px: same height at 1280 except the intended differences (Cases shorter without the draft markers and the SEN card; Ventura and Inside Blinds with titles without an em dash; Hospi aligned to the other cases), 390 within 9 px.
- A build against `staging` matches the build from the design seed on all 87 pages (text, heights, pixels).
- 48 pages at nine widths (320 to 1920): no horizontal scroll, side margins kept at 320.
- Lighthouse on eight pages, mobile and desktop: performance 100, CLS 0.000, accessibility 95-96. The remaining accessibility finding is the contrast of the brand red on small text (white on red 4.36:1, red on cream 3.89:1), a design decision left open.
- `npm test` (30), `astro check` 0 errors, `sanity schema validate` 0 errors.

## Not in this PR

- The reviewed alt texts themselves: they are applied after the review, in one transaction.

- The per-document `seo` overrides in Sanity are not read by the new pages yet; titles and descriptions come from the content.
- `studio:deploy`, after production is migrated.
params.title: Rebuild cides.be to the 2026 design system
